# Malicious decode corpus (generated by TestGenMalicious -update; do not edit).
# <file> <expected Go error> C="<C v1.5.7 error>" [tags] <what it targets>
#   expected: an exported sentinel (errors.Is), "corrupt" (an error matching
#     no sentinel) or "unexpected-eof" (io.ErrUnexpectedEOF).
#   C: ZSTD_getErrorName from cref (decompress, or dstream when tagged), both
#     run with -max-window-log 29; "incomplete" is dstream ending mid-frame.
#   gen:<name> cases exceed 8 KiB and are not committed; maliciousCases builds
#     them in memory.
#   tags: dstream = checked with ZSTD_decompressStream; raw-dict=<file> = the
#     zstd/testdata file loaded as a raw-content dictionary.
# Truncations of every frame type at every byte are TestTruncationsCRef's,
# built at test time.
